support_topology: Irregular support; marginal min/max values do not establish a full Cartesian grid or universal domain coverage.

units.growth_constraint_target_raw: original biomass-reaction flux; multiply by 1000 to express the archived growth rate in h^-1

required_lookup_metadata: Exact preprocessing, coordinate scaling, interpolation/neighbour selection and out-of-support behavior from the adopted implementation.
Cache-key rounding and query-order identity; record the 2022 recovered-cache exception.
Never silently regenerate responses using a model file, switch response lineage, extrapolate with new rules, or replace table coverage with marginal ranges.

changes: Isolated imports and a three-field ResponseConfig; changed the cfg type annotation only.
No response-query arithmetic, sorting, coordinate scaling, clipping, selection, weighting, cache or fallback logic changed.
query_implementation.backend_requirement_for_archived_regress: SciPy cKDTree. The original NumPy fallback is retained and has separately archived test expectations.
query_implementation.known_replay_dependency: Cache entries retain the first full-precision query for a rounded key. Exact historical lake replay requires query order and recovered 2022 cache identity; a cold-cache reordering is not declared equivalent.

field_descriptions.env_id: Producer environment identifier. Lookup deduplicates and assigns deterministic V16ENV identifiers, which differ from these source labels.
field_descriptions.temp_C: Recorded water-temperature query coordinate; not evidence of a Q10 rescaling in the upstream LP.
field_descriptions.rho_growth_commitment: Fraction of maximum biomass flux fixed by an equality during the toxin-capacity solution.
field_descriptions.mu_max_h: Maximum growth rate on the archived h^-1 basis.
field_descriptions.mu_committed_h: Committed growth rate on the archived h^-1 basis.
field_descriptions.toxin_capacity_upper_per_gDW_h: MC-LR capacity in mmol gDW^-1 h^-1. This column is not multiplied by 1000.
field_descriptions.mu_toxin_solution_h: Biomass rate in the toxin-capacity solution on the archived h^-1 basis.
field_descriptions.growth_constraint_target_raw: Biomass equality target in raw flux units; times 1000 gives h^-1.
field_descriptions.biomass_flux_toxin_solution_raw: Raw biomass flux in the toxin-capacity solution; times 1000 gives h^-1.
field_descriptions.growth_constraint_residual_raw: Signed raw-flux residual relative to the biomass equality target.
field_descriptions.growth_constraint_mode: Reported biomass-constraint mode; equality in every formal row.
field_descriptions.toxin_solution_status: Reported optimization status; optimal in every formal row.
field_descriptions.response_mode: Producer lineage label retained in the unchanged source table.
